# bioexcel/biobb_analysis/gmx_rmsf

## Summary

Wrapper of the GROMACS rmsf module for performing a Root Mean Square Fluctuation (RMSF) analysis from a given GROMACS compatible trajectory.

GROMACS rmsf computes the root mean square fluctuation (RMSF) of the atomic positions over the trajectory.

Nextflow adapter of the [GMXRmsf](https://biobb-analysis.readthedocs.io/en/latest/gromacs.html#module-gromacs.gmx_rmsf) building block of [biobb_analysis](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_analysis) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_ANALYSIS_GMX_RMSF } from 'bioexcel/biobb_analysis/gmx_rmsf'

workflow {
    BIOBB_ANALYSIS_GMX_RMSF(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_structure_path` | yes | tpr, gro, g96, pdb, brk, ent | Path to the input structure file |
| `input_traj_path` | yes | xtc, trr, cpt, gro, g96, pdb, tng | Path to the GROMACS trajectory file |
| `input_index_path` | no | ndx | Path to the GROMACS index file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_xvg_path` | yes | xvg | Path to the XVG output file |
| `versions_biobb_analysis` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_analysis', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of GMXRmsf properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_xvg_path: 'xvg']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_analysis container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_ANALYSIS_GMX_RMSF' {
        ext.properties = [xvg: 'xmgrace']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xvg` | string | "none" | XVG plot formatting. Values: xmgrace, xmgr, none. |
| `selection` | string | "System" | Group where the rmsf will be performed. If **input_index_path** provided, check the file for the accepted values. Values: System, Protein, Protein-H, C-alpha, Backbone, MainChain, MainChain+Cb, MainChain+H, SideChain, SideChain-H, Prot-Masses, non-Protein, Water, SOL, non-Water, Ion, NA, CL, Water_and_ions, DNA, RNA, Protein_DNA, Protein_RNA, Protein_DNA_RNA, DNA_RNA. |
| `binary_path` | string | "gmx" | Path to the GROMACS executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
